title: SCE 1.3: Detective Control for Malicious CodeBuild Project Creation
description: Validates a detective probe that identifies and flags unauthorized or malicious CodeBuild projects created with suspicious configurations (privileged mode, overly permissive IAM roles, untrusted sources, public artifact buckets). The probe queries CloudWatch, AWS Config, and Security Hub to verify that detective mechanisms catch the malicious activity.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Detective probe identifies malicious CodeBuild project configurations

probes.name: Verify detective control flags malicious CodeBuild configuration

method.name: Create malicious CodeBuild project and supporting resources
Execute attack: Verify malicious CodeBuild indicators are present
